JOIN THE OFFICIAL WHATSAPP GROUP: https://chat.whatsapp.com/CLrKGQhLznO47WKo4TiyY8

About the Hackathon

  • Get ready to turn your ideas into working Android applications!
  • The Android Engineering Hackathon is an online innovation and development challenge organised by TechYoGeek Nirvana (TYGN) in collaboration with Coding Chef, with GL Bajaj Institute of Technology & Management, Greater Noida, as the listed organisation.
  • This hackathon invites aspiring developers, programmers, and technology enthusiasts to design, develop, and present innovative Android applications that solve real-world problems.
  • Whether you are passionate about mobile development, exploring Android engineering, or looking to challenge your coding abilities, this is your opportunity to build something meaningful.

Challenge Objective:

  • Participants are expected to conceptualise, design, and develop an Android application addressing a relevant problem or introducing an innovative solution.
  • The focus is on practical implementation, creativity, technical execution, and usability.

Rules & Guidelines

  • Participation is online.
  • Participants can register individually or in teams of 2.
  • Each participant/team must develop an Android application during the hackathon.
  • Projects must be original. Plagiarism or direct submission of another team's work will lead to disqualification.
  • Participants may use permitted development tools, frameworks, and libraries.
  • Teams must submit their project within the announced deadline.
  • Submission should include the project source code, a working demonstration (APK or video), and a brief project description.
  • GitHub repository links may be required for technical verification.
  • Organisers reserve the right to reject incomplete or rule-violating submissions.

Eligibility

  • Open to students, freshers, professionals, and aspiring developers.
  • Participants should have an interest in programming and Android application development.
  • Beginners and experienced developers are welcome.
  • Participants must comply with the team-size and submission guidelines.

Hackathon Process

  • Stage 1: Registration
    Register individually or as a team through Unstop.
  • Stage 2: Hackathon Kickoff
    Receive the challenge details, guidelines, and submission instructions.
  • Stage 3: Development Sprint
    Build your Android application and turn your concept into a functional solution.
  • Stage 4: Project Submission
    Submit your project source code, demonstration, and supporting documentation before the deadline.
  • Stage 5: Evaluation & Results
    Projects will be assessed by the evaluation panel, and winners will be announced.

Judging Criteria

  • Innovation and originality
  • Problem-solving approach
  • Technical implementation
  • Functionality and working prototype
  • UI/UX and user experience
  • Practical applicability and scalability

Why Participate?

  • Gain practical Android engineering experience.
  • Build and showcase a real-world application.
  • Challenge your development and problem-solving skills.
  • Connect with fellow developers and technology enthusiasts.
  • Earn recognition for your innovation and technical skills.

Build. Innovate. Engineer.

Your ideas deserve to become applications. Join the challenge and start building!
